vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Reconcile hotel booking and inventory data using SQL and transparent status categories.
requirements.zh: 使用 SQL 及透明状态分类核对酒店预订与库存数据。

requirements.en: Produce descriptive revenue-support reporting and explain uncertain denominators or excluded records.
requirements.zh: 制作描述性收益支持报表，并解释不确定分母或被排除记录。

requirements.en: Maintain documented data changes and coordinate unresolved issues with property teams.
requirements.zh: 维护有记录的数据变更，并与酒店团队协调未解决问题。

requirements.en: Preferred: own final pricing decisions and independently deploy automated rate-optimization models.
requirements.zh: 优先：负责最终定价决定，并独立部署自动化房价优化模型。
